cards.hyp: Is the thruster a generic Chinese part, and are its listed dimensions real?
cards.note: → CAD v2.0: kick-up mount on the transom (decision 0004); coupon → C005
cards.notes: FAILS_AND_FIXES draft: 143. The thruster is taller than the draft (C001, 08.10) → duct OD 72.27 mm (box drawing says 77 mm, 112 mm long), frame face → prop axis 47.10 mm, frame 9.68 mm thick, 4 brass inserts, screws M4 (thread 3.93 mm) × 28.4 mm from outside, cable Ø5.62 mm with 4 wires (black + red thick, white + yellow thin), mass 201 / 206 g. CAD v1.9 stern pad was a guess (44 × 44, tp_z 25, tp_pitch 20, M3): wrong screw size, wrong pattern, and a 72 mm duct cannot be fully under water at a 42 mm draft. Hole pitch c-c 34.8–35.3 × 15.2–16.0 from four readings. Decision (Teddy): kick-up mount on the transom, hinge above the waterline. Next: test coupon 50 × 30 × 5 PETG, 4 × Ø4.5 at 35.0 × 15.6. Lesson: measure the bought part before drawing its mount.
cards.result: duct Ø72.27 × 112 (box says 77), mounting face 47.10 above the axis, frame 9.68, M4 (3.93) at 34.8–35.3 × 15.2–16.0, 201/206 g, cable Ø5.62 with 4 wires. Listing dimensions are not real; a 72 mm duct does not fit under a 42 mm waterline on a flat pad
cards.title: Cuifati thruster: dimensions, bolt pattern, mass
cards.label: C001

cards.hyp: 3 equal pairs under 1 Ω = motor phases (external ESC needed)
cards.note: → C006: 9 V with 0.10 A limit in a bucket
cards.notes: From the listing (same text under other brands, not confirmed for this unit): PWM 50 Hz, 1500 µs = stop, 1500→2000 forward, 1500→1000 reverse; 12–14.8 V, up to 13 A, under 8 A average at 12 V; no BEC; do not run dry > 10 s. Logic level and arming not documented. Meter: EMOS MD-220.
cards.result: 4 wires, not 3. No shorts. red↔black ~1.0 kΩ; yellow↔black 316 Ω / 8.86 kΩ reversed; white↔black 911 Ω / ~50 Ω reversed. Asymmetric = electronics inside (ESC). Red +, black −; yellow probably signal, white probably signal ground
cards.title: Thruster: the 4 wires, ESC or phases (no 12 V)
cards.label: C002

cards.hyp: plate 152.2 × 134.8, centred on the tracks; slots land under the beams at 385 / 500 (±2)
cards.note: → CAD v2.0: ch_x 300, slots in the box, beams match-drilled through the plate slots; → C004
cards.notes: Start time unknown; loop time not counted. Repeat caliper readings spread up to 0.8 mm. Lesson: a plate centred on the footprint is an assumption.
cards.result: plate 151.82 × 134.8; slots 3.2 wide, 11.3 and 26.4 mm from the edges (≈114 ±0.8 apart); with ch_x 290 they land at 375 / 489 → 10 mm off the beams. Chassis kit 1175 g → draft 41.8
